summary: QuickType prediction continuity and more visible iOS-style word transitions after signed v1.0.213. Oppo visual acceptance remains pending.

changes.title: Stable QuickType suggestions and animated word replacements
changes.detail: Immediately filter earlier native candidates to the current typed prefix while the decoder runs without a typing debounce. Keep three stable suggestion views and reuse five-chip views instead of rebuilding the row. Briefly hold an empty next-word result with old taps disabled, then clear after 164 ms. Animate retained prefix letters, inserted/removed letters and unrelated whole-word crossfades; retarget confidence pills from their visible state. Initial suggestions are already present when the keyboard opens, without entrance motion. Preserve protected fields, autofill, Emoji, native ranking/learning, BR Brain, offline voice, package and signing. Latest iOS timing parity and Oppo appearance remain unverified.
